emails.buyer: Province of British Columbia — Procurement Services Branch (BC Bid)
emails.contact_verified_at: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/bc-procurement-resources/bc-bid-guides/pdf-guides/supplier_demo_slides.pdf (BC Bid Help Desk address in the Province's own supplier guide; the Help Desk is run by the Procurement Services Branch)
emails.why_asking: Largest Canadian portal we can't use: BC Bid robots.txt is a blanket Disallow, and the BC Data Catalogue's contract-award file is 'Access Only' (no reuse licence). Covers ministries, health authorities, school districts, municipalities and BC Housing.
emails.subject: Free extra distribution for facilities tenders on BC Bid
emails.body:
Hello BC Bid team,

PMRFP (pmrfp.com) is a free board where commercial roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, janitorial, landscaping, snow and general contractors in Canada and the U.S. look for building and maintenance work.

We'd like to list the facilities and construction opportunities posted on BC Bid — ministries, health authorities, school districts, municipalities and BC Housing — on PMRFP, at no cost to you, the posting organizations or bidders, so they reach more local contractors.

What we would show: the opportunity title, a short summary, closing date, the buyer contact and a link back to the official posting on BC Bid. BC Bid stays the official source. We don't copy documents, bidders register and submit through BC Bid as usual, and we update or remove any listing on request.

BC Bid's robots.txt asks automated tools not to read the site, so we haven't, and we'd only proceed with your agreement. If that's acceptable, a reply saying so is enough. If you'd prefer, you can point us to a feed or export you're happy for us to use, or tell us whether the BC Bid award summaries in the BC Data Catalogue can be reused under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia.

Thank you,

R. Talkar
PMRFP · pmrfp.com · info@pmrfp.com
Talkerstein Consulting Group, 5050 Dufferin St., Toronto, ON M3H 5T5
If you'd rather not hear from us again, reply "unsubscribe".

emails.buyer: Government of the Northwest Territories — Procurement Shared Services (Contract Event Opportunities)
emails.contact_verified_at: https://www.fin.gov.nt.ca/en/services/3-help/frequently-asked-questions ("If you have any procurement-related questions you are encouraged to email: Procurement_Questions@gov.nt.ca")
emails.why_asking: gov.nt.ca terms: material "may not be used or reproduced for commercial purposes without the prior written consent" — so written consent is exactly what unlocks it. Covers GNWT departments and Housing NWT repair/maintenance tenders across the territory. The quarterly contracts report on opendata.gov.nt.ca is months behind, so it isn't a substitute.
